name: Inclusion ~Suishou no Furiko~
source:
New college student Futaba arrives at school one day to find the dead body of a professor--and it seems the professor's death was less than natural.  Then Futaba comes into the possession of a crystal belonging to the late professor, and his life takes a turn for the strange and inexplicable....

[Translated from [url=http://www.ritzsoft.com/data/catalog/html/Ritz-019.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
大学新生Futaba一天来到学校，发现一名教授的尸体——而教授似乎并非自然死亡。此后，Futaba得到了一块属于已故教授的水晶，他的生活也开始变得怪异而无法解释…

[翻译自[url=http://www.ritzsoft.com/data/catalog/html/Ritz-019.html]官方网站[/url]]
